name: Tachikawa Saeko
source:
A girl whose hobby is listening to the radio.
Because of some incident in her past she isn't very good at socializing and doesn't make new friends.
She's a big fan of [url=/c70125]Archange Madoka[/url] who is the lead personality of her favorite radio show.
